$comment: Map of Lyra's areas for the backend to grant per-company permissions. Keys are stable ids shared with the app: never rename one, deprecate it and add a new one.

contract.permission_id: <area key>.<action>, e.g. 'finance.payments.record'. The area key is dotted from the root area down.
contract.view_rule: '<area>.view' opens the area (side bar option, tab or route). Without it the app hides the option and refuses the route (deep links too). A child's view requires its parent's view.
contract.granting: The backend grants catalog keys (`<section>` or `<section>.<action>`, backend lib/models/permissions/catalog.js) and maps every id here to the keys its endpoints require (areas.js). A master keeps the same keys and the same map (docs/offline/specs/session.md, P-1 to P-4). There are no wildcards: the owner holds `all`.
contract.scope: Permissions are per company: a person can work for several with different roles. Areas with scope 'account' do not depend on a company and are never filtered by it.
contract.init_shape: GET /init/ answers `permissions`: per company id, the ids granted, nested and only the granted ones (`{business: {view: true, employees: {view: true, invite: true}}}`). A master answers the same, plus `owned`: the company ids the person owns.
contract.backend_must_enforce: The app only hides what is not granted; every endpoint, and every op of a master, checks the catalog key the id maps to. A new id here is a line in the backend's areas.js (and its copy in lyra_protocol) in the same change.
contract.modes: Deployment modes the area exists in: 'cloud', 'local', 'hybrid'. Every area declares it (docs/plan-offline-lan.md §12); the app mirrors it in CapabilityService.modes, kept equal by test/capabilities_test.dart. An area with 'cloud' but not 'hybrid' is cloud only: hidden in local, and in hybrid open while the internet is.
contract.action_modes: An action that exists in fewer modes than its area (deleting the company, company e-mails) declares its own, under 'action_modes'; the app reads it as the area '<area>.<action>'.

action_notes.view: The person's own settings, from their card in the employees tab: language and theme (this device).
action_notes.security: Password and second factor (authenticator app, email code, recovery codes).

action_notes.view_personal: Full profile: personal data, emergency contact, pay, notes.
action_notes.invite: Invite a person by email with a job title; with `permissions`, also a permissions template (not while a master syncs: P-12).
action_notes.permissions: Grant and revoke other people's permissions, and answer permission requests.

action_notes.edit: Profile data: legal name, handle, activity, fiscal id, phone, website, sector, language, country.
action_notes.manage_emails: Add, edit and verify company emails.

action_notes.take_over: Pause the assistant / return the chat to it.
action_notes.assign: Assign the chat to a team member.
action_notes.view_usage: AI cost of the open session.

action_notes.create: New delivery (coming soon, no endpoint yet).

action_notes.view: Side panel from the deliveries desk's header, no route of its own.
action_notes.edit: Delivers/pickup flags, delivery note, flexible areas, delivery options.

action_notes.view: Drawn and edited on the deliveries desk itself (its panel and map), no route of its own.

action_notes.view_all: Without it only the person's own sales are listed ('sold by me').
action_notes.approve: PUT /chats/stage STAGE=sold: confirm a payment at 'verifying'.

action_notes.templates: Starting tables by the company's activity, offered while it has no table (the backend's catalogue; a master has none).
action_notes.transfers: Stock sent to and received from another branch (`inventory.transfer`, `inventory.receive` in the catalog); a master is one site.
action_notes.prices: A product's own price at a branch (`products.price` in the catalog); a master is one site.
action_notes.edit_table: Rename, colour, header data and agent settings of a table.
action_notes.edit_columns: Create, rename, retype, reorder and delete fields.
action_notes.edit_records: Write cells and rows in the spreadsheet.
action_notes.move_stock: Take/add stock from the stock summary.

action_notes.edit: Role, data source, payment accounts, tools, credentials.
action_notes.toggle: Enable/disable; start/stop the WhatsApp Personal session.

action_notes.create: Write a question, with or without its answer.
action_notes.edit: Answer the questions Lyra left, change an answer, its branch, dates and products, turn it on or off.

action_notes.export: Accounting export of sales, payments, receivables and stock movements (CSV/XLSX). Local and hybrid first (docs/offline/specs/money.md).

action_notes.view_bot_cost: What Lyra's assistant cost (POST /money/ai): measured in the cloud, so not in local.

action_notes.manage_currencies: Add/edit exchange currencies and custom rates. The main currency is never written from the app.

action_notes.sell: Add catalog products to the ticket (holds stock).
action_notes.custom_amount: Line with a typed concept and price, outside the catalog.
action_notes.cancel_ticket: Discard the ticket, releasing its holds.

action_notes.backups: Run, schedule and restore encrypted backups.

always_open.$comment: Never gated: they come before a company exists or are the person's own.
